changelog:
A live channel no longer stops when its audio carries a damaged frame header.

WHAT CHANGED

- Some live channels carry Dolby Digital (AC-3 or E-AC-3) audio with an occasional damaged frame header. Until now one such header stopped the channel: the picture froze, went black, and every retry stopped again within seconds. Now the damaged piece of audio is skipped, a fraction of a second, and the channel plays on.
- A channel whose audio is damaged throughout, with no good audio for a couple of seconds, still stops with an error rather than playing on in silence.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.5: Plex episodes and films can be sent to your television, and the playback stats panel is its own setting.
